mapper.select: select count(case when s.is_group = 0 then 1 end) as indv_total, count(case when s.is_group = 0 and s.status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 end) as indv_success, count(case when s.is_group = 1 then 1 end) as group_total, count(case when s.is_group = 1 and s.status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 end) as group_success from ( select 0 as is_group, chr.status as status, chr.date as date, chr.user_id as user_id from challenge_records chr union select 1 as is_group, chr.status as status, chr.date as date, chr.user_id as user_id from challenge_group_records chr ) s where s.date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and s.user_id = #{userId};
